We moved to the area 2 years ago. I’ve had one interaction with the surgery on a phone call consultation just because I couldn’t remember exactly my medication doses for my diabetes and blood thinning medication. The doctor was condescending and it felt like she was accusing me of trying to steel medication. I still haven’t got my meds….

My wife had just started a work from home job, doing PIP assessments. She became unwell and because she said that she couldn’t make the appointments on offer as she was working. She was told by the receptionist, obviously you are not that sick.

Last month my wife was ill, flu like symptoms but added to it her skin on her back and face felt like it was on fire and terribly itchy. On a phone consultation was told by the doctor this doesn’t normally happen will flu… never mind the fact it’s happening. We had to take photos and upload them via a link that was sent to us. That was about two weeks ago. We still haven’t heard anything.

Maybe we are just unlucky, and have caught everybody on a bad day. I’m not sure if anyone else feels like this. When I’ve called I found there is one lady that is not very helpful. That is all I can say.
